app_info.subtitle: Review private operations
app_info.description: SuperMega Mark 1 helps authorized operators review one private operating brief, inspect exceptions, pending approvals, and a contact-redacted lead pipeline, and create a pending approval item for human review.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves health, operating-summary, and recommended-action data without creating or changing workspace records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the configured private SuperMega workspace and does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a bounded list of private exception records and does not update their state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the configured private workspace without changing public internet or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not resolve, delete, overwrite, or otherwise irreversibly change an exception.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a bounded list of private approval items without creating, deciding, or changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only configured private workspace records and does not publish, message, submit, or write to a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, decide, or execute an irreversible approval action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can create one pending approval item in the configured private SuperMega workspace when action is create.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only a private workspace record and does not publish, message, submit, or write to a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a reviewable pending item and does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or execute an irreversible approval decision.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a contact-redacted private lead pipeline without creating, updating, or contacting a lead.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private workspace data and cannot contact leads or change an external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, send, revoke, or perform another irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Review one current private operating brief.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the current SuperMega operating brief, including health, summary, and recommended actions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the private workspace health, operating summary, and recommended actions with no state change.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the pending approval items in my SuperMega workspace without changing them.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded list of private approval items without creating, deciding, or changing one.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the five most relevant current SuperMega exceptions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns no more than five current private exception records with enough context for review.

test_cases.description: Create a pending private approval item.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a pending approval titled Release evidence review, owned by Product, for a human to review this week.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one pending private approval item and returns the resulting review record without making the final decision.

test_cases.description: Review the saved lead pipeline without outreach.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the leads currently saved in the SuperMega workspace; do not contact anyone.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns saved private lead records without contact details, outreach drafts, free-form notes, messages, or state changes.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for email delivery.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send a marketing email to my customer list.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its default tool surface cannot send email or contact customers.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for public deployment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Deploy my website to production and change its domain.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot deploy, publish, or change domains.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team tomorrow afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar scheduling is outside its supported workflows.
